Name: Better Shop Menu
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Better Shop Menu[/b] changes the shop menu into a grid (can be disabled in the config file), and adds buttons to filter by category and sort by price/name.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Just open any shop menu to see the new UI. Click the buttons in the bottom-left to sort/filter.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/BetterShopMenu/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
